app_desc.message: Shows the original Crunchyroll subtitle and its translation into the language you choose at the same time.

cmd_toggle_overlay.message: Turn the dual subtitles on or off

cmd_toggle_translation.message: Show or hide the translation line

popup_toggle_title.message: Turn the dual subtitles on or off (Alt+Shift+S)

prefer_official.message: Use Crunchyroll's own subtitle in that language when it exists

merge_sentences.message: Translate sentences split across lines as a whole

note_google.message: Free and needs no key. Fast, but it translates line by line without seeing the scene.

note_deepl.message: A free DeepL API account gives 500,000 characters a month (an episode is roughly 15–20 thousand). Free keys end in :fx.

gemini_key_link.message: Get a free key from Google AI Studio

note_gemini.message: Reads the scene and the previous lines, so it is clearly better than Google Translate. The free tier has request limits; AI Studio shows which model you can use and what the limits are. Google may use content submitted on the free tier to improve its products.

note_claude.message: Translates with the scene and the previous lines in mind; the highest quality. Roughly per 24-minute episode: Opus 5 ≈ $0.30–0.45, Sonnet 5 ≈ $0.12–0.18, Haiku 4.5 ≈ $0.06. Translations are cached, so the same episode is never paid for twice.

instructions_ph.message: e.g. Keep it casual. Leave honorifics like -san and -kun. Do not soften swearing.

perm_needed.message: $1 needs permission before it can be used.

perm_denied_keep.message: ✗ permission for $1 was not given; the previous service stays in use.

preset_tv_title.message: For watching across a room: bigger text, darker backdrop, higher up

preview_tr_before.message: Hurry and we can still catch the meteor

show_signs.message: Show signs and on-screen text too

strip_hardsubs.message: Remove the subtitle burned into the video

strip_hardsubs_hint.message: (applies to the next episode, or after the page is reloaded)

hide_native.message: Hide the player's own subtitle layer

lift_with_controls.message: Lift the subtitle while the controls are showing

word_lookup.message: Show a word's meaning on hover

word_lookup_hint.message: (with dual subtitles; its counterpart in the translation is coloured too)

notebook_save.message: Click a word to file it in the notebook

notebook_save_hint.message: (with its meaning, part of speech, sentence and episode)
